summary: Allow multi-MB sprint index reconciliation and discovery stale retry

delivery.outcome: Resolve semcod/planfile#403 by raising MAX_REPAIR_SECONDS from 2.0 to 8.0 in planfile/core/index_repair.py so background server._repair_ticket_index() reconciles ~7 MB current.yaml incrementally within budget and restores GET /tickets/discovery to HTTP 200 without 200s full rebuilds, qualifying this path in tests/test_index_repair.py without modifying store.py or sqlite_index.py.
nonGoals: Do not weaken GET /tickets/discovery read-only isolation or rebuild inside GET handlers.
Do not modify planfile/core/store.py or planfile/core/sqlite_index.py (reserved by active foreign tickets).
Do not weaken bounded byte/ticket caps or signature race refusal in index_repair.py.

architecture.decision: Keep bounded MAX_REPAIR_BYTES/MAX_REPAIR_TICKETS and read-only discovery intact while raising MAX_REPAIR_SECONDS to 8.0 in planfile/core/index_repair.py so multi-MB current.yaml deltas reconcile incrementally during maintenance instead of triggering 200s full rebuilds.

validation.evidence: Simulated 2.6s current.yaml parse reconciles incrementally within MAX_REPAIR_SECONDS=8.0 with zero full archive scans.
Read-only GET /tickets/discovery stays 503 while stale and returns HTTP 200 once background _repair_ticket_index completes incremental reconciliation.
Over-budget reconciliation continues returning None and preserving 503 with Retry-After: 2.
